modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On June 11, 2002: Antonio Meucci is acknowledged as the first inventor of the telephone by the United States Congress.
On June 11, 1998: Compaq Computer pays US$9 billion for Digital Equipment Corporation in the largest high-tech acquisition.
On June 11, 1987: Diane Abbott, Paul Boateng and Bernie Grant are elected as the first black MPs in Great Britain.
On June 11, 1968: Lloyd J. Old identifies the first cell surface antigens that could differentiate among different cell types.
June 11 is observed as King Kamehameha I Day (Hawaii, United States).
